brief_title: Role of Metformin in Posterior Capsule Opacification
official_title: Lens Epithelial Cell Proliferation in Patients Suffering From Diabetes and Treated With Metformin in Vitro: a Pilot Study

lead_sponsor.name: Vienna Institute for Research in Ocular Surgery

interventions.name: Blood and lens capsule samples for PK testing

intervention_names: Diagnostic Test: Blood and lens capsule samples for PK testing
arm_groups.label: Metformin Concentration in Blood Serum and Lens capsule

primary_outcomes.measure: Metformin concentration in the human lens capsule

brief_summary: Determination of concentrations of systemically applied metformin in human lens capsule and its ability to lower the proliferation rate of human lens epithelial cells in vitro.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age-related cataract
* Diabetes mellitus type II
* Metformin treatment
* Age 21 or older
* Written informed consent prior to surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diabetes mellitus type I
* Previous ocular surgery or trauma regarding cataract surgery
* Previous vitrectomy
* Pregnancy (pregnancy test will be taken in women of reproductive age)
